scenario.task:
I want to fix my mobile phone because the cellular data is extremely slow and web pages won't load

User Guide: The user complains about slow data speeds. They will verify their identity and ask for help resetting their network settings or checking their data status If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
